themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to autonomously conduct research, analyze data, or perform complex research tasks with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often integrated directly into IDEs.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses AI-powered platforms and tools that facilitate various aspects of the research process, from data collection to analysis and discovery.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Details how AI is being integrated into design workflows and research methodologies to enhance creativity, efficiency, and insight generation.

themes.name: AI tools comparison
themes.description: Features articles that compare the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI tools for specific applications like research or coding.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Highlights integrated AI platforms designed to support a broad spectrum of research activities, often offering multiple functionalities in one place.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI applications that condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, aiding in information digestion and quick understanding.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the study and development of AI chatbots, including their capabilities, limitations, user interactions, and potential harms.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Explores AI applications that assist in creating, distributing, and analyzing surveys to gather user feedback and market insights.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting job markets, skill demands, employment rates, and the overall nature of work across various industries.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
